commits.message: refactor(diagnostics): placeInserts' per-cell kinds map is typed, so its non-empty miss lists stay non-empty (candybar-law-review-ibyq.aa1)

fix(diagnostics): an advisory keeps its typed subject until the draw names it, one insert cell is one advisory per kind of cause, and the renderer wire version moves with the snapshot (candybar-law-review-ibyq.aa1)

ConfigSnapshot.notices changed shape, so RENDERER_WIRE_VERSION is 17 and an old recording is refused at the version check. Advisory carries a LoadSubject, derived into an About once by loadAbout, so the kind and text forms are unrepresentable for a load warning. An insert cell's misses group by kind of cause, naming each tree, matching what the identity names.

fix(diagnostics): a load warning is born about a typed subject, an insert cell is named by what it says and not its list position (candybar-law-review-ibyq.aa1)

About moves below the loader so producers emit it; every load advisory is built by one constructor over a closed LoadSubject, so no producer spells its identity. Insert refusals carry a typed cause, the three discovery notices return their own advisory, and a non-Error thrown by a variable declaration no longer escapes its catch. The tests that read warnings as text are migrated, with producer-level identity tests.
fix(diagnostics): a load warning carries the subject its producer knew, so fixing one leaves the viewer on another whose line moved (candybar-law-review-ibyq.aa1)

fix(diagnostics): a message's about carries the rule that names it, so two load warnings are two messages

about was a bare string built four ways, and every load warning was about the bare kind, so two shared an identity and only list position told them apart: fixing the first left a viewer open on the second closed.

about is now a kind, a kind's subject, or the message's own text, built by its constructor, and the identity hashes each by rule. A load warning is about its text; the fault note reads its kind and subject from the same value.
